title: Lower Thermite to Verus-annotated Rust and verify at L3 and L1

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Transpile AST -> Verus-annotated Rust source, then invoke Verus. Mapping: req->requires, ens->ensures (must mention result for non-unit), inv->invariant, dec->decreases, fx pure -> no side effects, spec fn -> Verus spec fn. Each SpecTherm combinator lowers to its registry Verus definition. L1 rung: compile the same SpecTherm contract to runtime checks (executable spec fns) active in ALL build profiles, not just debug (design 6). Overflow is a proof obligation (design 4.4). Defer: runtime effect sandbox (compile-time fx subsumption only).

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Critic loop-4 audit (commit 3e5daba): GENERALITY CLAIM VERIFIED — proof-aid templates are shape-keyed, not per-program hardcoded. Grep: zero program-identity coupling in lower.rs (only vocabulary literals 'len'/'None'/'forall_in'/'forall_below'/'forall_from'). New-program probes (thermite-lower/tests/divergence_lower.rs) lower renamed-but-structurally-identical programs: 'tally'/'accumulate'/'vals'/'total'/'j' emits lemma_tally_push + vals@ aids and VERIFIES under real verus; 'locate'/'data'/'key'/'left'/'right' emits a data@/left/key coverage split and VERIFIES; a no-shape fn emits NO spurious aids; a combinator in req position lowers with the @ view. No emitted cheats (no assume/admit/external/external_body/slag/ensures-true). Gauntlet green: thermite-lower 5+6 passed, thermite-spec 19, clippy/fmt clean. NO DIVERGENCE FOUND. One low-pri observation #37 (cosmetic underscore drop, thermite-syntax).

VERIFIED BY EXECUTION via rustc (not byte-match): positive sum(&[1,2,3])==6 with checks passing; negative corrupted-body fires the always-active violation handler (observable, non-zero exit). 8 combinator L1 fns unit-tested over concrete slices (AC-3). Gauntlet: thermite-lower 18 passed (7 new l1_conformance) + thermite-spec 19 (l1 field did not break #2), clippy/fmt/workspace-build clean. Commit c0b1d8a. #4 STAYS OPEN: acto-critic re-audit + effects.rs (effect-subsumption) remain.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content:
SHIPPED — all three components of #4 done and critic-verified. (1) L3 lowering [lower.rs + combinator Verus forms]: emitted Verus for both corpus programs VERIFIES in real verus via GENERAL shape-keyed proof-aid templates (critic proved generality on renamed programs; no per-program hardcoding). (2) L1 runtime checks [l1.rs + combinator L1 forms]: emitted L1 compiles+runs, always-active checks fire on violation incl under release; critic NO DIVERGENCE. (3) Effect subsumption [effects.rs]: compile-time fx-row subsumption; critic found #38 (while-condition callee escaped the walk) -> fixed by walking every reachable Expr position; pinned test green.

Also fixed the verus-test portability bug the user hit: verus tests now skip-loudly when verus is absent instead of panicking, AND CI installs the pinned verus release (URL corrected + verified end-to-end) so the L3 gate actually runs in CI.

Commits: 3e5daba/cc8214c (L3) -> e3c398e/57008d0 (verus skip) -> 6b02abb/c0b1d8a/cb3caa4/a8d45f5 (L1) -> 83afe1b (CI verus) -> 5b0967f/a595a5f/95d12b9 (effects + #38). Final: cargo test --workspace all green (57 thermite-lower+thermite-spec tests, both corpus programs verify at L3 in real verus), clippy -D warnings + fmt clean. Not pushed. Deferred per design: SMT triggers refinement, the ladder degrade L3->L2->L1 + cert manifest (issue #5 forge check), runtime effect sandbox (issue #21).
